Graded response model on the PRO items alone

Source: R/grm.R
fit_grm.Rd

Fits a unidimensional logistic GRM with mirt (`itemtype = "graded"`, defaults) and orients the latent trait so that the sum of the slopes is positive (higher \(\eta\) = higher item scores). For an item whose top categories nobody used, mirt estimates no threshold for them; the missing intercept is set 20 logits below the previous one, so the category has probability close to zero everywhere, and the threshold should be reported as not estimable.

Usage

fit_grm(Y, SE = FALSE)

Arguments

Y

matrix or data frame of item responses scored 0..3 (NA allowed), one column per item; column names are used as item names

SE

passed to [mirt::mirt()]

Value

list(a, d (items x 3), eap, converged, orientation, items, mirt)
